title: Amazon Bedrock Long-term API key (ABSK): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: ABK in place of ABSK, one letter of the prefix dropped, prefix: ABSX in place of ABSK, and prefix: the documented upper-case ABSK spelled lower case. Twin of "Amazon Bedrock Long-term API key (ABSK): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of aws-bedrock-long-term-api-key-curl-bearer: prefix: the documented upper-case ABSK spelled lower case. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
